name: SVR Poker Android

tablePolicy.championReset: All six seats restart at 10,000 on the next hand after one funded player remains.
tablePolicy.leaveRejoinReset: A deliberate table leave followed by rejoin starts a fresh six-player table at 10,000 each.
tablePolicy.humanBustBehavior: The remaining funded players continue until a champion exists; the table does not reset merely because the human stack reaches zero.

realDeviceValidation.target: Verify the Android table starts at 10,000 per seat, the visible 15-second clock follows every active player, timeout folds occur, continuous hands do not freeze, and leave/rejoin restores a fresh 10,000-chip table.

updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 362 changes the remotely loaded Android web runtime and does not require reinstalling APK 0.1.0-rc1.
Phase 347 remains the only Android MOVE, LOOK, and poker-button controller.
Phase 357 seating and showdown presentation remains protected authority.
Phase 336 remains the poker rules and settlement authority.
Phase 362 adds tournament policy, a cross-platform turn clock, timeout folds, champion reset, and deliberate leave/rejoin reset.
Historical Phase 354 browser evidence remains recorded separately from the Phase 362 60,000-chip policy acceptance.
APK version name 0.1.0-rc1, version code 1, manual-update-only, forceUpdate false, and showUpdatePrompt false remain locked.
